Attachments: crate_manifest_v4.pdf (manifest we sent previously).

Please confirm the following ASAP:
- Current yard address and contact person (phone + email)
- Whether the crate is in a bonded/CBP-approved facility or just an offsite holding yard

We are on a tight timeline — booth build for Redwood starts 12/05. If there are paperwork gaps tell me exactly what you need from us and we will provide it within the hour. If there will be any fees for expedited clearance or on-site exam please estimate.

Thank you — we need a short readout in the next 60 minutes so we can decide whether to divert the backup crate from our advance warehouse.

Tessa — quick update from ops: we received notice from the terminal at 08:40 that your inbound was not available for same-day gate-in due to a backlog; the driver was instructed to offload to OffSite Park (OSP Bonded Yard) at 1721 Industrial Way.

Status:
- Yard: OSP Bonded Yard (bonded: yes)
- Current hold reason: Customs flagged the shipment for a missing consignee decon code on the import filing. Broker attempted to refile but needs an authorization letter from your importer of record to proceed with release.
- Temperature: no excursion recorded at handoff per driver's handheld; however, we are requesting the yard provide a temperature check to be safe.
- On-site broker: none at the moment — Harper Customs Brokers can be there but require the authorization.

Attachments: provisional_receipt_1203.pdf (OSP receipt).

Action items we need from Redwood now:
1) Signed release/authorization naming Harper Customs Brokers to act as agent (we can send a template).
2) Importer of record full legal name and EIN/Tax ID.

If you can provide those two items in the next 45 minutes we can dispatch Harper for an immediate exam and push for same-day release; otherwise the crate will remain in bonded yard until broker availability tomorrow (12/04).

1) Approve up to $1,200 for expedited broker/on-site exam fees + yard release charges (likely allows release same day).
2) If leadership does not approve, we must accept a 24–48 hour hold and divert our backup crate from the advance warehouse to the show site (adds transport and rework risk).

Requested approvals:
- Approve expedited clearance spend (yes/no)
- If yes, authorize Camila to sign off on payment and release paperwork.

I will stand by to make the call and coordinate with BlueWave/Harper. Please reply within 30 minutes so we can get the broker on site while they still have availability.
